summary.zh-TW: 說明目前只寄送國內，附上代購的說明
summary.en: Explain we ship domestically only and point to forwarding

body.zh-TW:
@@ reply/to
陳先生
@@ reply/subject
海外寄送的詢問
@@ reply/greeting
陳先生您好，謝謝您的詢問。
@@ reply/p2
目前我們只寄送國內地址，暫時無法寄往海外。若需要寄往海外，可以先寄到國內的代收地址，再由代購或轉寄服務處理。
@@ reply/closing
〔1〕轉寄服務的費用與時間由該服務決定，我們無法代為負擔或保證。〔/1〕如有其他問題歡迎再與我們聯繫。
body.en:
@@ reply/to
Mr. Chen
@@ reply/subject
Question about overseas shipping
@@ reply/greeting
Dear Mr. Chen, thank you for your question.
@@ reply/p2
We currently ship to domestic addresses only and cannot ship overseas. If you need the item abroad, you can ship it to a domestic receiving address and use a forwarding service from there.
@@ reply/closing
〔1〕Fees and timing for forwarding are set by that service; we cannot cover or guarantee them.〔/1〕 Please let us know if you have any other questions.

@@ kb/supplier-orders | 供應商下單流程
@@ kb/supplier-orders#owner [required] | 負責部門
〔1〕採購組〔/1〕
@@ kb/supplier-orders#steps [required] | 步驟
1. 在採購表單填寫品項與數量。
2. 金額超過 NT$ 50,000 時，由〔1〕採購組〔/1〕主管核准。

2025 年 3 月
body.en:
@@ kb/supplier-orders | Supplier ordering process
@@ kb/supplier-orders#owner [required] | Owner department
〔1〕Purchasing〔/1〕
@@ kb/supplier-orders#steps [required] | Steps
1. Fill in the items and quantities on the purchase form.
2. Orders over NT$ 50,000 are approved by the 〔1〕Purchasing〔/1〕 lead.
3. Once approved, send the order and record the expected arrival date on the form.
@@ kb/supplier-orders#updated [point 2] | Last updated
March 2025
